title: Basic Plan
description: Perfect for beginners who want to access the essentials of the gym and start their fitness journey.

title: Standard Plan
description: Designed for individuals looking for more variety with group fitness classes and a personal touch with personal training.

title: Premium Plan
description: A comprehensive plan for those serious about fitness, including unlimited group classes, additional personal training, and nutrition guidance.

title: Ultimate Plan
description: The all-inclusive plan for fitness enthusiasts who want maximum access, priority support, and exclusive perks like guest passes.

title: Student Plan
description: Affordable for students, this plan offers all the essential gym services along with fitness classes, all at a discounted price.
